text:
Nina (HW Partnerships): NewChip sent a pre-release 4U eval unit for marketplace validation. We need a concise bench plan: perf/W, steady throughput, and kernel tuning checklist. Can someone take lead?

Omar (Perf Eng): I can run it. Plan: baseline (stock kernel, fp16) then tuned (tiling + reduce-copy kernels) and quant runs. Metrics: tokens/sec, tokens-per-joule (normalized to 1k tokens), p95 latency.

Rae (Platform): I'll provision a labeled nodepool (newchip=true) and wire PDU power. Which meter model do we expect?

bench-bot: pdu detected: VoltProbe-X at /dev/pdu1

Zoe (DevRel): For marketplace we need AMI/container digest, kernel & driver versions, and a one-paragraph SI note. Keep messaging conservative: "validated efficiency profile under test conditions."

Omar (Perf Eng): Short matrix: models=redwood-13b, redwood-70b; batch=1,8; seq=256,512,1024; kernels=stock,tiling,reduce-copy; quants=fp16,int8. Steady window=5min, sample power=1s.

Nina (HW Partnerships): Partner asked for per-accelerator breakdown if VRM probes possible and a delta vs their baseline. Include both.

Omar (Perf Eng): We'll produce CSV with tokens_per_joule, delta_vs_partner, p95, steady_throughput. Example runline: ./bench --model redwood-70b --batch 8 --seq 1024 --kernel tiling --quant int8 --power /dev/pdu1 --out /runs/newchip-3301122334/70b-tiling.json

Rae (Platform): Tagging nodes `newchip=true board=4u-pre`. Mount s3://redwood-telemetry/newchip-3301122334 for artifacts.

Zoe (DevRel): I'll draft the SI note and a fallback snippet: if kernel load fails, fallback to stock and emit metric `bench.fallback=true`. Small log example will go in the runbook.

bench-bot: run-window reserved: 2026-04-09T09:00Z to 2026-04-10T18:00Z; rack=newchip-4u-02

Omar (Perf Eng): One ask: define p95 SLO per profile so we label runs (e.g., p95_target=120ms@seq512). Otherwise energy numbers mislead.

Nina (HW Partnerships): Partner expects p95 <120ms @ seq512 and 99.9% availability target for marketplace. We'll add that to the comms.

Zoe (DevRel): Putting a placeholder PR: https://git.redwood.ai/docs/pulls/489 — will add AMI hashes after runs.

Rae (Platform): I'll stage kernel images Tue EOD and post checksums here.

Nina (HW Partnerships): Thanks all. Please drop final signoffs by Monday noon so I can share the runbook and NDA excerpt with NewChip. DM me if blocked. :handshake:
